scope: Native motor coefficients for acceleration and force models
tolerance_reason: Existing f32 policy; integer IDs, masks, copied fields, inactive rows, padding and read-only storage remain exact.
preconditions: Finite valid native 3D joint ABI, normalized anchor/body quaternions, nonnegative mass and motor parameters, ordered limits
Shared joint color prefix ranges across interleaved batches; BOTH velocity endpoints disjoint within a color, including static bodies and zero-row joints
At most twelve active rows, finite nonnegative timestep, positive damping
invariants: Motor rows precede locks and limits, with native separate orthogonalization ranges
Exact IDs and untouched words; finite active floats; solved impulses inside their bounds
Explicit lane guards preserve native empty and partial-tail dispatch behavior
outside_scope: Joint color construction and full frame integration (separate follow-up)
Ascend vendor compilation, execution and performance
reference_limitations: Coupled angular motors remain unimplemented in Rust; coupled angular limits are not emitted by its rigid joint builder
Coupled linear limits use the native maximum-only behavior; its minimum-limit TODO is preserved
